ما هو أنا لازم أفتح عيني مشان أدور عليكي.
بس إنت يا جلجل بتعد بسرعة

لا لا يا جلجل، بالعكس يعني عشرة،
عد كمان مرة من واحد لعشرة

زي من واحد لعشرة ما رح يكون أبطأ.
بس إنت بتعد بسرعة. طيب خلاص،
عد من واحد لعشرة بس مو بسرعة شوي شوي.
حاضر، رح أعد من واحد لعشرة

أنا عدت كتير بطيء يا تن تن.
خلاص جلجل، هلق رح أتخبى منيح
بس عد كمان مرة يا جلجل شوي شوي.
حاضر، رح أعد شوي شوي هالمرة.
يلا أنا هلق جاهزة عشان أتخبى،
جلجل، أنا تخبيت وإنت ما لقيتني.
طب أنا هلق مين بده يلاقيني؟

phrases.text: I don't know where to hide.
This is hide-and-seek, you're not supposed to open your eyes.
You have to start over and count from the beginning.
But you need to hurry and hide.
Where should I hide so Jaljal doesn't find me?
What do you think, help me where should I hide?
Behind the tree? No, I'll be seen.
Tan Tan, ready for me to look for you?
Not yet, Jaljal, why do you keep opening your eyes?
I have to open my eyes to look for you.
But you, Jaljal, are counting fast
And I didn't manage to hide.
I'm still very slow, Tan Tan.
Come on, let's try one more time.
No, Jaljal, we need to try another way.
No no, Jaljal, backwards means ten,
Dad, Jaljal is still counting fast.
I'm being slow, little by little.
I don't want you to count backwards,
Count again from one to ten
But not fast, little by little.
Now I want to go hide quickly.
Tan Tan, it won't make a difference
If it's backwards or something else.
I counted from ten to one
Just like one to ten, it won't be slower.
But you count fast. Okay fine,
Count from one to ten but not fast, little by little.
Okay, I'll count from one to ten
Like this, Jaljal will see me.
Where to hide, I don't know.
Ten, Tan Tan ready for me to look for you?
I counted very slowly, Tan Tan.
Okay Jaljal, now I'll hide properly
But count one more time, Jaljal, little by little.
Okay, I'll count little by little this time.
Come on, I'm ready now to hide,
Jaljal, I hid and you didn't find me.
So now who's going to find me?
